en.summary: See your FreeVideo version and what changes before you update.
changes: A short product version is now shown in the launcher and creative workspace. The build number remains available in version details.
Update reminders include release notes in your selected language: English or Simplified Chinese.
Open Version & release notes at any time, including after updating or while offline, to read the notes included with your installed version.

zh.summary: 查看 FreeVideo 版本，更新前了解本次变化。
changes: 启动器和创作面板显示简短产品版本，构建号可在版本详情中查看。
更新提醒附带更新说明，跟随界面语言显示中文或英文。
随时打开「版本与更新说明」，更新后或离线时也能查看当前版本自带的说明。
